issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Animal subclasses in example code: the template's commented example instantiations in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java use two-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), whereas the exercise UML and the solution implementation define and use single-argument constructors that initialize only the animal's name (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle")). This inconsistency can confuse students about the required constructor signature (whether a second attribute is expected) and which constructor they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make constructor usage consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the commented example instantiations in template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use the single-argument constructors shown in the UML and solution (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle"), new Pig("Doodle"), new Goat("Buttinsky")). Alternatively, if an additional attribute is intended pedagogically, update the UML, problem statement, and solution to document and implement two-argument constructors consistently.
